sections.overview:
1. 整体市场概况和情绪

今日主要事件：

  • U.S.-Iran conflict reignites, yet oil prices fall against the trend: The U.S. launched a new round of airstrikes on Iran in the early hours, Iran retaliated against Gulf allies, and Trump had previously announced the end of the fragile ceasefire. But the market largely ignored it — USO is currently at $109.05 (-2.87%), XLE -1.25%, OXY -2.44%, and Brent has pulled back to around $77.6. Traffic through the Strait of Hormuz has slowed (only 6 tankers passed on Thursday), with the community joking that "war is back but oil prices are dropping like a rock."
  • Storage-sector three-day counterattack continues, semiconductors single-handedly support the market: SMH +3.43%, SOXL surging +14.08%. MU $1018.6 (+7.32%, surged to 1035 intraday before pulling back and getting stuck at 1000-1020), SNDK $1887.59 (+9.26%, approaching the 1900 level), AMD $551.64 (+6.60%), AVGO +3.61%, LRCX +7.15%, CRDO +5.93%, DRAM(ETF) +5.03%. QQQ +1.58% is almost entirely reliant on chips.
  • SK Hynix (SKHY) to list tomorrow, 7/10: $29 billion ADR, the largest U.S. listing by a foreign company in history (surpassing Alibaba and Aramco), 7x oversubscribed. The two camps are fiercely debating whether it will drain liquidity or act as a catalyst — but storage stocks rose instead of falling today, with bulls arguing that the liquidity drain already happened in advance over the past two weeks.
  • BAG7 diverges, META stages a big V-shaped reversal: META was once -4% at the open (falling to 577), now at $612.79 (+1.60%), nearly a 6% intraday reversal, driven by news that it is entering the AI coding race to catch up with Anthropic/OpenAI. GOOGL $355.52 (-1.72%, the worst performer), MSFT $379.66 (-0.90%, the "public enemy number one"), AMZN roughly flat. NVDA $202.55 (-0.74%) continues to decouple and weaken on its own.
  • Broad market: SPY $750.87 (+0.75%) battles hard at 750, IWM +1.28% as small caps strengthen, DIA only +0.33%. Low volume was the biggest feature of the day.
  • Fed minutes and 30-year Treasury auction also today, with the community worried that the auction result could trigger bond-market volatility. COST -4.10% (JPM trimmed its price target by just $10, triggering a selloff), PLTR -3.68%, PEP -3.24% were the drag names.

社区气氛：总体情绪看涨，但极度恼怒和困惑并存——仓储多头庆祝三天的反击，嘲讽空头（“bers”）屡屡受压，而许多交易者则对 SPY 被紧紧钉在 750 点、低成交量的“人工泵”和每根蜡烛收盘前的“救援反弹”感到愤怒和无奈。操纵理论已经达到了这个周期的顶峰。

恐惧/贪婪：有贪婪倾向，但缺乏信念。 VIX 被称为“过度自满”，大多数人押注于低波动性的横盘走势； “免费跨式卖出收取theta”已成为主流玩法。

情绪与价格行为：社区的看跌情绪与实际的绿色磁带严重脱节——评论部分充满了“请让 SPY 下跌”、“这是假泵”和“见顶了”，但市场不断走高，多头用它来嘲笑“做与 Reddit 相反的事情就能赚钱”。
